name: LOG-based Silhouette Detection
definition: A volumetric edge detection technique used to identify silhouette voxels for rendering sketch-like curves, replacing a more exhaustive 3x3x3 subspace search to improve performance.
summary: LOG-based Silhouette Detection identifies silhouette voxels for sketch-like curves in non-photorealistic volume rendering by replacing exhaustive searches with a precomputed Laplacian of Gaussian filter and thresholding.
